QuestInfo.name: Correcting the Past 2: Good Bye Miner
QuestInfo.0: Future Doctor Bing is looking for someone to prevent the collection of Fossil Minerals required to build a Time Machine.
QuestInfo.1: Go to the Mine in the past using the #b#p9250138##k and defeat the #b#o9420070#s#k that are collecting Fossil Minerals.
QuestInfo.2: You prevented the collection of Fossil Minerals, which are required to build a Time Machine.

0.0: Do you remember what happened in the Mine? You collected Fossil Minerals.
0.1: I will send you to the Mine of the past using a black whole activation device. You will be fighting against miners like yourself from the past.
0.2: Defeat as many miners as you can so that the Fossil Minerals won't be gathered.\n\rThe mining suits should prevent the people inside from getting hurt.

yes.0: The Black Hole has been activated. Now, hurry!

no.0: Not correcting the past is another mistake we cannot afford...

1.0: You're back! Thanks to your efforts, it seems many Maplers were able to gather the necessary Fossil Minerals to build their Time Machines. Whew!

yes.0: Still, they will keep trying. Come back tomorrow to lend another hand.

default.0: We still have a chance to fix this! Return to the past and try again!
